column2: Our invasion of [From.GetTitledName] can no longer go ahead. The longships are dragged back onto the shingle, the warriors drink the mead meant for the voyage and go home grumbling to their halls. The raid has failed before a single sail was raised.

I waited too long to launch the invasion of [From.GetTitledName]! The warriors who flocked to my banner have eaten my stores bare, and now they drift off to seek a bolder chieftain. The skalds will not sing of this.

Warbands have come down from every fjord and frozen valley of the north, their longships crowding the shore, to join our great expedition against [From.GetTitledName]! They want plunder, slaves and the eyes of the gods upon them.
A crew of hard-eyed raiders has rowed in to join our expedition against [From.GetTitledName]. Few as they are, they are hungry for blood and glory.

A renowned champion has come to my hall with his hearth-guard, the skulls of his enemies hung from his belt, to fight in our invasion of [From.GetTitledName]! The gods have marked him, and men already whisper his name.
Make room at the high table!
